screen_text.text:
def _line_hspan(box, lines):
"""找与 box 纵向重叠最多的 group_line，返回该行（x_min，x_max）；无则 None。"""
bx1, by1, bx2, by2 = box
best, best_ov = None, 0
for ln in lines:
ws = ln["words"]
if not ws:
continue
ly1 = min(w[1][1] for w in ws)
ly2 = max(w[1][3] for w in ws)
ov = max(0, min(by2, ly2) - max(by1, ly1))
if ov > best_ov:
best_ov = ov
best = (min(w[1][0] for w in ws), max(w[1][2] for w in ws))
return best if best_ov > 0 else None

screen_text.text:
judge 效应几乎为零 — 在 201 个两 judge 都成功的同一子集上配对：
总体 qwen-35b 51.1 vs gpt-5.4 50.2, Δ=+0.9

工程结论: judge 做 A/B 离散打分不必开 XXX(judge_prompt 本身已含逐候选显式分析), 关掉即可 300/300 干净、与 gpt-5.4 完全对等
